'''2000 Death Star II Pre-Release (Clifton Park)''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release held in Clifton Park, NY on 24 June 2000. [[Jonny Chu]] won it. It is known from Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d928">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-death-star-ii-clifton-park-nyd928/ death-star-ii-clifton-park-ny], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-death-star-ii-clifton-park-nyd928/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Clifton Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
